gloss: to be afraid of; to fear

definitions.gloss: to be afraid; to fear; to show fear
definitions.explanation: Used to describe when someone (typically a third person) displays behavior indicating they are afraid.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}を{怖|こわ}がる{子|こ}どもが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many children are afraid of dogs.

examples.japanese: {注射|ちゅうしゃ}を{怖|こわ}がらないで。
examples.english: Don't be afraid of the injection.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{何|なに}も{怖|こわ}がらない{性格|せいかく}だ。
examples.english: He has a personality that fears nothing.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive verb)

CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}) ending in る
・{怖|こわ}がらない (negative)
・{怖|こわ}がって (te-form)
・{怖|こわ}がった (past)

GRAMMAR NOTE:
This is the -がる form of the i-adjective {怖|こわ}い. The -がる suffix converts adjectives describing internal feelings into verbs that describe observable behavior.

{怖|こわ}い vs {怖|こわ}がる:
・{怖|こわ}い - (I am) scared, frightening
・{怖|こわ}がる - to be afraid of, to show fear (observed behavior)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜を{怖|こわ}がる - to be afraid of ~
・{怖|こわ}がらせる - to frighten, to scare (causative)
・{怖|こわ}がり - a scaredy-cat, timid person (noun form)

RELATED -がる VERBS:
・{欲|ほ}しがる - to want (from {欲|ほ}しい)
・{恥|は}ずかしがる - to be shy (from {恥|は}ずかしい)
・{寂|さび}しがる - to feel lonely (from {寂|さび}しい)
